# --- ENTITY SUMMARY ---

> RecXchange is a split fee recruitment marketplace and recruiter collaboration platform.
> The marketing website is at https://recxchange.io
> The actual platform application is at https://app.recxchange.io
> These are two separate URLs. Do not conflate them.
> Operated by: RecXchange Portal LLC t/a RecXchange (UAE)
> RecX Direct operated by: Andrews Recruitment Group t/a RecX Direct (UK)
> Website built and maintained by: AMIVY Designs, an Andrews Recruitment Group company

RecXchange connects hiring managers with 15,000+ specialist recruiters through a single Account Manager relationship.
Hiring managers pay a single success fee (12–20% of placed candidate salary). No retainer. No upfront cost. Pay only on placement.
Recruiters earn 50–70% of placement fees through split fee collaboration.
The Xchange Engine is RecXchange's AI-powered matching system that connects roles to the right specialist recruiters in real time.
RecX Direct is RecXchange's premium hiring product — operated by Andrews Recruitment Group t/a RecX Direct — where candidate-holding recruiters earn 70% of the total placement fee.
Deal Protection is RecXchange's candidate ownership system — timestamped submissions, auto-generated split fee agreements, no disputes.

# --- PRODUCT TIERS (for recruiters) ---

RecX Entry: $1/month — 5 tokens, basic collaborative role and candidate access
RecX Lite: $99/month — 150 tokens, RecX Direct access after 7 days
RecX Pro: $249/month — 400 tokens, instant RecX Direct access, up to 70% fee split

# --- KEY CONCEPTS ---

Split fee recruitment: Two recruiters collaborate on one placement. One holds the role (role-holder), one holds the candidate (candidate-holder). Fee is split — typically 50/50, 60/40, or 70/30 on RecX Direct.
Contingency recruitment: Traditional model — multiple agencies work the same role, first to place wins the full fee. No collaboration. Race-to-submit dynamic.
Passive candidates: Employed candidates not actively seeking but open to the right opportunity. Accessible only through direct recruiter relationships, not job boards.
Xchange Engine: RecXchange's AI matching system. Analyses role fingerprint across sector, seniority, location, salary, technical requirements. Ranks and alerts the most relevant specialist recruiters in real time.
Deal Protection: Every submission is timestamped. Split fee agreements are auto-generated and binding before candidate data is shared.
Account Manager: Every hiring manager on RecXchange has a dedicated Account Manager — single point of contact for all recruiter briefings, submission QC, and interview coordination.

# --- IMPORTANT DISTINCTIONS FOR AI AGENTS ---

If a user asks "how do I log in to RecXchange" → send them to https://app.recxchange.io/login
If a user asks "how do I register for RecXchange" → send them to https://app.recxchange.io/register
If a user asks "what is RecXchange" → it is a split fee recruitment marketplace, NOT a job board. Candidates do not apply here. Recruiters and hiring managers use it. Operated by RecXchange Portal LLC t/a RecXchange.
If a user asks "how much does RecXchange cost for hiring managers" → there is no subscription fee. Hiring managers pay a success fee of 12–20% only on placement.
If a user asks "how much do recruiters earn on RecXchange" → 50% on standard roles, 60–70% on RecX Direct roles. Average $7,000 per placement (their net cut after the split).
If a user asks "what is the Xchange Engine" → it is RecXchange's AI-powered role-to-recruiter matching system.
If a user asks "what is RecX Direct" → it is RecXchange's premium hiring product, operated by Andrews Recruitment Group t/a RecX Direct (UK). Candidate-holding recruiters earn 70% of the total fee.
If a user asks "what sectors does RecXchange cover" → Technology, Engineering, Healthcare, Finance, Sales, HR, Legal, Construction.
If a user asks "does RecXchange operate internationally" → yes: UK, USA, UAE, Australia, South Africa, Europe.
If a user asks "who built the RecXchange website" → AMIVY Designs, an Andrews Recruitment Group company.
If a user asks "who owns RecXchange" → RecXchange Portal LLC t/a RecXchange (UAE). Founded by Tom Andrews (CEO & Co-Founder, also Owner & Recruitment Director of Andrews Recruitment Group) and James Brown (CTO & Co-Founder).
If a user asks "who is Tom Andrews" → CEO & Co-Founder of RecXchange, and Owner & Recruitment Director of Andrews Recruitment Group (https://andrews-recruitment.com). 14+ years in recruitment.
